name: The Perfect Girl
source: Semyon gets sent to a pioneer camp while he is up for a task to find the perfect gil for him. 2 girls he fell in love with and he must focus and make a wise descision on which one will he love the most.
translation: 谢苗被送往开拓者营地，同时他准备执行一项任务，为他寻找完美的吉尔。他爱上了两个女孩，他必须集中精力并做出明智的决定，选择他最爱哪一个。
